component.name: aws2-sns
component.title: AWS Simple Notification System (SNS)
component.description: Publish messages to a topic of Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS).
component.label: cloud,messaging,mobile

autoCreateTopic.description: Whether the endpoint creates the topic when it starts, if no topic with this name exists in the region. A name that ends with .fifo creates a FIFO topic. If false and the topic does not exist, the publish fails.

batchEnabled.description: Whether the producer publishes a batch of messages instead of one. The body must then be a List of the PublishBatchRequestEntry of the AWS SDK, at most 10, and the producer replaces it with the PublishBatchResponse. The subject, messageStructure and message group and deduplication options and the headers are not used for a batch.

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of this component start from. Each endpoint gets a copy of it, and the options of the endpoint replace its values.

kmsMasterKeyId.description: The ID, alias or ARN of the AWS KMS key that encrypts the topic, for example alias/aws/sns for the AWS managed key of Amazon SNS. It is used only when the endpoint creates the topic and serverSideEncryptionEnabled is true, and it is required then.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

messageDeduplicationIdStrategy.label: producer
messageDeduplicationIdStrategy.description: How the producer sets the message deduplication ID for a FIFO topic: useExchangeId uses the ID of the exchange, and useContentBasedDeduplication sets none, so that Amazon SNS deduplicates by the content of the message, which the topic must enable. A FIFO topic that the endpoint creates with useContentBasedDeduplication has content-based deduplication enabled.

messageGroupIdStrategy.label: producer
messageGroupIdStrategy.description: How the producer sets the message group ID for a FIFO topic: useConstant puts all messages in one group, useExchangeId uses the ID of the exchange, and usePropertyValue the exchange property CamelAwsSnsMessageGroupId. Amazon SNS requires a message group ID for a FIFO topic, so set this option for one. It is not used for a standard topic.

messageStructure.description: Set to json to send a different message for each protocol: the body is then a JSON object with a default key and a key per protocol, such as email or sqs. The CamelAwsSnsMessageStructure header replaces this option. It is not used when batchEnabled is true.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

policy.description: The access policy of the topic, a JSON document that the endpoint sets on the topic when it starts, also on a topic that exists already. It is loaded from the classpath by default; use the prefix file: or http: to load it from another location.

queueArn.description: The ARN of the Amazon SQS queue that the endpoint subscribes to the topic when it starts, if subscribeSNStoSQS is true. The access policy of the queue must allow the topic to send messages to it.

region.description: The AWS region of Amazon SNS, as a region ID such as eu-west-1, which is the value of Region.EU_WEST_1.id(). If not set, the default region provider chain of the AWS SDK is used. When the topic is given as an ARN, its region replaces the region of the component, and this option on the endpoint replaces both.

serverSideEncryptionEnabled.description: Whether the topic that the endpoint creates, see autoCreateTopic, is encrypted with the AWS KMS key of the kmsMasterKeyId option. It does not change a topic that exists already.

subject.description: The subject of the message, which Amazon SNS uses as the Subject line of the email for email subscriptions. The CamelAwsSnsSubject header replaces this option. The producer cuts a subject longer than 100 characters, and does not use it when batchEnabled is true.

subscribeSNStoSQS.description: Whether the endpoint subscribes the Amazon SQS queue of the queueArn option to the topic when it starts. The queueArn option is required then.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

amazonSNSClient.label: advanced
amazonSNSClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.sns.SnsClient, which is autowired when the registry has a single one. When this option is set, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used. The endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP client of Amazon SNS connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP client of Amazon SNS connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP client of Amazon SNS uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. The endpoint requires it, unless amazonSNSClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

profileCredentialsName.label: security
profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. The endpoint requires it, unless amazonSNSClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.

trustAllCertificates.label: security
trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP client of Amazon SNS trusts every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.label: security
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.label: security
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

CamelAwsSnsMessageId.description: The ID that Amazon SNS assigned to the published message. The producer sets it after a publish, but not when batchEnabled is true.

CamelAwsSnsSubject.description: The subject of the message, which Amazon SNS uses as the Subject line of the email for email subscriptions. It replaces the subject option. The producer cuts a subject longer than 100 characters, and does not use it when batchEnabled is true.

CamelAwsSnsMessageStructure.description: Set to json to send a different message for each protocol, with the body a JSON object with a default key and a key per protocol. It replaces the messageStructure option, and is not used when batchEnabled is true.

CamelAwsSnsSequenceNumber.label: producer
CamelAwsSnsSequenceNumber.description: The sequence number that Amazon SNS assigned to the message in a FIFO topic. The producer sets it after a publish, with no value for a standard topic, and not when batchEnabled is true.

CamelAwsSnsFailedMessageCount.label: producer
CamelAwsSnsFailedMessageCount.description: The number of entries of the batch that Amazon SNS did not publish, which the producer sets when batchEnabled is true. The PublishBatchResponse in the body lists them with the reason.

CamelAwsSnsSuccessfulMessageCount.label: producer
CamelAwsSnsSuccessfulMessageCount.description: The number of entries of the batch that Amazon SNS published, which the producer sets when batchEnabled is true. The PublishBatchResponse in the body lists them with their message ID.

producerIn.description: The message to publish, as text: bytes, a stream or a file are read as text, and a Map or a POJO is sent as its toString(): marshal it first. With messageStructure=json, a JSON object with a message per protocol; with batchEnabled=true, a List of the PublishBatchRequestEntry of the AWS SDK

producerOut.description: Unchanged after a publish, with the id of the message in a header. With batchEnabled=true, the PublishBatchResponse of the AWS SDK

topicNameOrArn.description: The name of the topic, or its ARN in the form arn:aws:sns:region:account:name. For a name, the endpoint looks up the ARN of the topic in the region when it starts, and creates the topic if autoCreateTopic is true and none exists. A topic whose name ends with .fifo is a FIFO topic.

autoCreateTopic.description: Whether the endpoint creates the topic when it starts, if no topic with this name exists in the region. A name that ends with .fifo creates a FIFO topic. If false and the topic does not exist, the publish fails.

headerFilterStrategy.description: To use a custom HeaderFilterStrategy to choose which headers the producer sends as message attributes. The default skips the headers that start with Camel or camel, and breadcrumbId. A header is sent only if its value is a String, Number, Date, byte[], ByteBuffer or List.
